name: Galvannealed A40
notes: Standard at DCI; heat-treated zinc coating; good paint adhesion.

name: Galvannealed A60
notes: Similar to A40 with slightly thicker zinc coating.

name: Galvanized G90
notes: No annealing; highest corrosion resistance among the three; visible spangle.

name: Cold Rolled Steel (CRS)
notes: Raw finish; less protection; requires phosphate wash for paint.
Used for specific specialty frame product.
Used for specific specialty frame product.

label: 20-minute
notes: Often paired with S-label for smoke when gasketing is applied.

label: 60-minute
notes: 3-sided frames from DCI commonly provided as 90-minute even if 60 requested (opening rated to LOWER of components).
applies_to: doors (60), frames often 90 for single/paired openings

label: 180-minute
notes: Highest standard rating for hollow metal; three hours.

relocation_notes: May be relocated to avoid being covered by continuous hinges.
Chosen for durability; location varies by hardware.

visibility_rule: On the UL label when leakage test met
relocation_notes: Requires UL 1784 and perimeter gasketing on stops.

name: Fail Safe
definition: Unlocked when power is interrupted; power applied to lock.
notes: Releases upon fire alarm or outage for safe egress.

name: Fail Secure
definition: Locked when power is removed; power applied to unlock.
notes: Stays locked during outages; mechanical override typically required.

name: Raceway (conduit)
definition: Internal conduit path through door/frame for wiring.
common_use: From EPT/electric hinge to lock edge
notes: DCI door raceways ~0.5in dia with pull-wire; Molex connectors typically won’t pass.

name: Von Duprin EPT-10 (example)
definition: Electrical Power Transfer between frame and door on hinge side.
notes: Locate per hardware schedule; mirrored or single depending on design.

rule: All fire-rated doors must be self-closing.
method_examples: Surface closer or concealed closer; spring hinges (less common, typically 2 for commercial).

rule: All fire-rated doors must be self-latching (positive latching).
method_examples: Latch engages automatically on close; cannot be reopened by simple push/pull.

rule: Labels must remain visible to AHJ after install.
method_examples: Relocate label when continuous hinges used.

rule: DCI often manufactures 3-sided frames to 90 min while doors may be 60; opening rating is the lower of the two.
method_examples: Order may show 60-min door / 90-min frame; opening = 60 min.

rule: Provide explicit raceway path and wire count on order.
method_examples: e.g., 'from 3rd butt hinge to lock edge'; note any Molex needs.

frame_policy: No raceway in 3-sided frames; run in mullion/transom if required
